name: comp-50
title: Card Details Form
description: A compact card entry group: one wide card-number row with a brand logo slot, split below into expiry and CVC boxes. Digits are grouped automatically and the generic card glyph becomes a Visa badge.
use: A checkout or billing step needs the three standard card fields with automatic brand detection and a tidy grouped look.
avoid: It needs the react-payment-inputs dependency and only renders fields, with no validation text or pay action.
a11y: The inputs and focus rings work, but fields depend on placeholders and library aria labels, and the heading is not tied to them. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Under a small "Card Details" heading, three dark fields join into one block with shared hairlines and rounded outer corners: a full-width number row with a small card glyph at its right, then an MM/YY box and a CVC box side by side.
behaves: Typing numbers spaces the card number into groups of four, and once the first digits name the brand a coloured Visa badge replaces the plain card glyph. Focus raises a ring around whichever field is active; the expiry and CVC boxes accept their own values.
customise: There are no props: heading, field order and vendor credit are fixed, so changing layout, labels or copy means editing the file.
weight: light: Three inputs and a small brand badge; no loops, timers or heavy drawing.
demo: Heading "Card Details", placeholders Card number, MM/YY and CVC, a 4242 test number and the React Payment Inputs credit.
polishWhy: Tidy joined group and a live brand badge; otherwise plain stock inputs plus a vendor credit.
